title: Depth of the binarized circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose each gate has pairwise distinct arguments and every negation gate has exactly one argument. If circuit depth is the depth of its output vertex, then binarizing $C$ gives a circuit of depth at most $(\lceil\log_2(\mathrm{size}(C))\rceil+1)$ times the depth of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Each gate has pairwise distinct arguments
Each negation gate has exactly one argument
